items.rationale: The frame carries genuine theft damage, so it is a repair cost under 2.3.1(b) and 7.1.1(b). The EUR 500 mobility aggregate sub-limit (4.2.2) bites: about 958 of indemnifiable lines are scaled by roughly 0.52, so ~300 becomes ~157.
The brakes carry theft damage, so they are a repair cost. Scaled rateably under the EUR 500 aggregate sub-limit: ~145 x 0.52.
The tracker was not taken or damaged; it is supplementary equipment procured in connection with the loss. Excluded under 4.2.3, 3.1.7 and 7.1.8(b).
This is servicing of an unaffected item. Excluded under 3.1.6, 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(a)/(b).
These are newly procured accessories and protective equipment, none of which was affected by the theft. Excluded under 4.2.3 and 3.1.7.
Carriage of replacement parts is part of the repair cost under 7.1.7(f). Prior ~26, scaled by the sub-limit factor ~0.52.
Attendance is only covered where required by the repair (7.1.7(g)); the reference case had this line below 27, possibly 0. If paid, ~25 x 0.52.
Fitting the replacement frame and brakes is part of the repair under 7.1.7(c). About 110, scaled by 0.52.
Sundries are nominally covered under 7.1.7(e), but this line type was never paid historically and reference case 24 had it below 8. If paid, the amount is tiny and scaled.
Covered in principle under 7.1.7(d), but reference case 24 had this line below 18, possibly 0. If paid, ~17 scaled by 0.52.
Repair labour under 7.1.7(d). Reference ~35-42, scaled by 0.52.
Recovery attendance under 5.2.2(a), but it falls inside the EUR 500 aggregate class sub-limit. The reference had it below 35, so ~30 x 0.52.

items.description: Cut and remove seized lock, 2 pcs
items.rationale: Recovery cost under 5.2.2(b). Prior ~108, scaled rateably under the 4.2.2 sub-limit to ~56.
A further attendance is covered only if actually required by the recovery (5.2.2(a), 7.1.8(f)). It is flagged as an extra call-out and was never paid historically.
A third-party release charge is expressly covered under 5.2.2(c) and 3.1.5: 100 + VAT = 119. Scaled by 0.52 under the EUR 500 aggregate sub-limit.
Claim-processing charges are excluded under 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(d).
Recovery labour of every grade is covered under 5.2.2(b), but similar lines were historically below 18. If paid, ~15 x 0.52.
Recovery labour under 5.2.2(b). Reference ~35-40, scaled by 0.52 under the class sub-limit.
